correctness.rationale: Two complete source implementations (Python neighborhood signatures and BFS; C++ independent indexing and DSU) enumerate all 262144 labeled vertex subsets, all legal one-bit changes and all capacities 6 through 18. Packaged sources and stdout are reproducible; no infinite extension asserted.

value.rationale: The six-detector optimum on C3 square C6 is a naturally extremal sensor-placement case. The exact first threshold for connecting all optimal codes is 9; the second, different threshold for connecting every feasible code is 10, with a sharp obstruction of 60 inclusion-minimal nine-detector traps. This is a motivated complete finite configuration-space result not implied by the already-known minimum, and matters to safe incremental migration between placements.
